segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ סֵדֶר תְּקִיעוֹת: שָׁלֹשׁ שֶׁל שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁלֹשׁ. שִׁיעוּר תְּקִיעָה כְּשָׁלֹשׁ תְּרוּעוֹת, שִׁיעוּר תְּרוּעָה כְּשָׁלֹשׁ יְבָבוֹת. תָּקַע בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָשַׁךְ בַּשְּׁנִיָּה כִּשְׁתַּיִם — אֵין בְּיָדוֹ אֶלָּא אַחַת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The order of the blasts» is «three» sets «of three» blasts «each,» which are: Tekia, terua, and tekia. «The length of a tekia» is «equal to» the length of «three teruot,» and «the length of a terua» is «equal to» the length of «three whimpers.» If «one sounded the first» tekia of the initial series of tekia, terua, tekia, «and» then «extended the second» tekia of that series «to» the length of «two» tekiot, so that it should count as both the second tekia of the first set and the first tekia of the second set, «he has in his hand» the fulfillment of «only one» tekia, and he must begin the second set with a new tekia.

segments.he: מִי שֶׁבֵּירַךְ וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְמַנָּה לוֹ שׁוֹפָר — תּוֹקֵעַ וּמֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים.
segments.en: With regard to «one who recited the blessings» of the additional prayer, «and» only «afterward a shofar became available to him, he sounds» a tekia, «sounds» a terua, «and sounds» a tekia, an order he repeats «three times.»

segments.he: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁשְּׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר חַיָּיב, כָּךְ כׇּל יָחִיד וְיָחִיד חַיָּיב. רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: שְׁלִיחַ צִבּוּר מוֹצִיא אֶת הָרַבִּים יְדֵי חוֹבָתָן.
segments.en: «Just as the prayer leader is obligated» in the prayer of Rosh HaShana, «so too, each and every individual is obligated» in these prayers. «Rabban Gamliel» disagrees and «says:» Individuals are not obligated, as «the prayer leader fulfills the obligation on behalf of the many.»
